verses.en: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.
verses.sm: Ua tutū i luga i latou uma lava, ua ta‘ita‘i ia te ia ia Pilato.

verses.en: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.
verses.sm: Ona latou momoli ai lea ia te ia, ua faapea atu, Na matou iloa lenei tagata ua ia faasese i le nuu, ua vavao foi ona avatu o taulaga ia Kaisara, ua faapea mai, o ia lava o le Tupu, o Keriso.

verses.en: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it.
verses.sm: Ona fesili mai lea o Pilato ia te ia, ua faapea mai, O oe ea o le tupu o tagata Iutaia? Ua tali atu ia ia te ia, ua faapea atu, O lea lava.

verses.en: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.
verses.sm: Ona fai ane lea o Pilato i le au faitaulaga sili ma le motu o tagata, Ou te le iloa se mea e sala ai lenei tagata.

verses.en: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.
verses.sm: A ua latou finau pea, ua faapea mai, Ua faaoso e ia i le nuu, ua a‘oa‘o i Iutaia uma, ua afua mai i Kalilaia ua oo mai iinei.

verses.en: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo Pilato ia Kalilaia, ona fesili ane lea o ia, pe se tagata Kalilaia o ia.

verses.en: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e ia, o ia mai le itu malo o Herota, ona avatu lea o ia ia Herota, o ia foi sa i Ierusalema i ia ona po.

verses.en: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.
verses.sm: Ua iloa atu e Herota ia Iesu, ona fiafia tele ai lea o ia; auā ua leva ona fia matamata ia te ia, ona o mea e tele ua logo mai ia te ia; ua faamoemoe foi o ia na te vaavaai i se faailoga e faia e ia.

verses.en: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
verses.sm: Ua fesili mai o ia ia te ia i upu e tele; a e lei tali atu e ia se upu ia te ia.

verses.en: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.
verses.sm: Ua tutū i luga le au faitaulaga sili ma le au tusiupu, ua naunau lo latou momoli ia te ia.

verses.en: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.
verses.sm: Ua faaleaogaina o ia e Herota ma lana ‘au, ma tauemu mai ia te ia, ua latou faaofu foi ia te ia i le ofu pupula, ona toe au mai ai lea o ia ia Pilato.

verses.en: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.
verses.sm: Ua toe lelei o Pilato ma Herota i lea lava aso; auā sa muai feitagai i laua.

verses.en: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
verses.sm: Ona faapotopoto lea e Pilato le au faitaulaga sili, ma le au faipule, ma le nuu,

verses.en: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:
verses.sm: ona fai atu lea o ia ia te i latou, Ua outou au mai lenei tagata ia te au, e peiseai se faasese i le nuu; faauta mai foi, ua ou suesue ia te ia i o outou luma, ou te lei iloa se mea e sala ai lenei tagata i mea ua outou molia mai ai ia te ia.

verses.en: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.
verses.sm: A ua le iloa foi e Herota; auā na ou aauina atu outou ia te ia; faauta foi, e leai se mea ua faia e ia e tusa ai ona oti o ia.

verses.en: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, ou te aoai atu ia te ia, i le ou tatalaina atu ai.

verses.en: (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)
verses.sm: (E ao ina tatalaina e ia o se tasi tagata ia te i latou i le tausamiga.)

verses.en: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas:
verses.sm: A ua alaga mai le motu o tagata uma lava, ua faapea mai, Ave ese ia lena tagata, a ia tatala mai Parapa ia te i matou.

verses.en: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)
verses.sm: (O le tagata lea na tuuina i le fale puipui, ona o le fouvale sa faia i le aai, ma le fasioti tagata.)

verses.en: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.
verses.sm: Ona toe tautala atu ai lea o Pilato, ina ua fia tatalaina atu Iesu.

verses.en: But they cried, saying, Crucify him, crucify him.
verses.sm: A ua latou leo tetele mai, ua faapea mai, Ina faasatauro ia, ina faasatauro ia ia te ia.

verses.en: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu faatolu foi o ia ia te i latou, Se a foi lona leaga ua na faia? Ou te lei iloa se mea e faasalaina ai o ia ia oti; o lea foi ou te aoai atu ai ia te ia, i le ou tatalaina atu ai.

verses.en: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.
verses.sm: A ua latou faatauanau mai ma leo tetele, o fai mai ia faasatauroina ia; ua malo o latou leo ma leo o le au faitaulaga sili.

verses.en: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu e Pilato, ia faia lo latou manao.

verses.en: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.
verses.sm: Ua tatalaina e ia ia te i latou o le na tuuina atu i le fale puipui ona o le fouvale ma le fasioti tagata ua latou fai mai ai; a ua tuuina atu e ia o Iesu i lo latou manao.

verses.en: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.
verses.sm: Ua latou ta‘ita‘i atu ia te ia, ona latou pue atu lea ia Simona, o le tasi Kurene ua sau mai le vao; ua latou faaee ia te ia le satauro e faafuata ai ma mulimuli ia Iesu.

verses.en: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.
verses.sm: Ua mulimuli atu ia te ia le motu o tagata e toatele, ma fafine, e ua taufaitagitu‘i, ma taufaitagiaue ia te ia.

verses.en: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.
verses.sm: A ua fāliu Iesu ia te i latou, ua fetalai atu, Tama fafine a Ierusalema e, soia le tagi ia te au, a ia outou tagi ia te outou, atoa foi ma a outou fanau.

verses.en: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.
verses.sm: Faauta foi, e oo mai ona aso, e fai mai ai tagata, Amuia e ua pa, ma fafine e lei fananau, ma susu e lei susuina.

verses.en: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o tagata i mauga, Mafuli mai ia ia te i matou; e fai atu foi i mea maupuepue, Ina ufiufi ifo ia ia te i matou.

verses.en: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?
verses.sm: Auā afai e faia nei mea i le laau mata, se a se mea e fai i le laau mago?

verses.en: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.
verses.sm: O isi foi pagotata e toalua, ua ta‘ita‘iina atu faatasi ma ia, ia fasiotia.

verses.en: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.
verses.sm: Ua latou oo atu i le mea e ta‘ua o le mea o i ai le ulupoo, ua latou faasatauro ia te ia i lea mea, ma e pagotata, o le tasi i le itu taumatau, ma le tasi i le itu tauagavale.

verses.en: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu, Lo‘u Tamā e, ia e faamagaloina atu ia te i latou; auā ua latou le iloa le mea ua latou faia. Ua tufatufa e i latou ona ofu, ona fai ai lea o le vili.

verses.en: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.
verses.sm: Ua tutū mai le nuu, ma matamata mai. O le au faipule foi ua tauemu mai ia te ia faatasi ma i latou, ua faapea mai, Na faaolaina e ia nisi tagata, ina faaola ia o ia ia te ia, pe afai o le Keriso lena ua filifilia e le Atua.

verses.en: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,
verses.sm: Ua tauemu mai foi ia te ia tagata tau; ua o ane ia te ia, ma avatu i ai le vineta,

verses.en: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.
verses.sm: ua faapea atu, Afai o oe o le tupu o tagata Iutaia, ina faaola ia oe ia te oe.

verses.en: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.sm: Na tusia foi le tusi i ona luga, i le upu a Eleni, ma Roma, ma Eperu, O LE TUPU LENEI O TAGATA IUTAIA.

verses.en: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.
verses.sm: O le tasi foi o e na pagotata ua faatautauina ua upu leaga o ia ia te ia, ua faapea mai, Afai o oe o le Keriso, ina faaola ia oe ia te oe atoa ma i maua nei.

verses.en: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?
verses.sm: A ua tali atu le tasi, ua vavao ia te ia, ua faapea atu, E te le mata‘u ea i le Atua, ina ua tatou sala faatasi?

verses.en: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.
verses.sm: Ua tonu lava la ta sala; auā ua tauia mai i taua e tusa ma mea na ta faia; a o ia nei, e leai se mea e le tusa na faia e ia.

verses.en: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o ia ia Iesu, Le Alii e, ia e manatua mai a‘u, pe a e afio mai i lou malo.

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu ai lea o Iesu ia te ia, E moni, ou te fai atu ia te oe, o le asō ta te faatasi ai ma oe i parataiso.

verses.en: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.
verses.sm: Ua oo i le itu aso po ua ono, ona pogisa uma ai lea o le nuu, ua oo lava i le itu aso e iva.

verses.en: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.
verses.sm: Ua faapouliuliina foi le la; o le ie puipui foi o le malumalu ua saeluagalemuina.

verses.en: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.
verses.sm: Ona valaau ai lea o Iesu, ua leo tele, ua faapea atu, Lo‘u Tamā e, ou te tuuina atu lo‘u nei agaga i ou aao; ua na fetalai ia upu, ona to ai lea o lana mānava.

verses.en: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e le ta‘ita‘i o le toaselau le mea ua faia, ona vivii atu lea o ia i le Atua, ua faapea atu, E moni, o le tagata amiotonu lenei.

verses.en: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.
verses.sm: O tagata uma e ua faapotopoto e maimoa i lea mea, ua vaavaai i mea ua faia, ona pōpō lea o i latou i o latou lava fatafata, ma toe foi atu.

verses.en: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.
verses.sm: Ua tutū mamao atu foi tagata uma e sa masani ma ia, atoa ma fafine e na mulimuli mai ia te ia mai Kalilaia, ua vaavaai mai i latou i ia mea.

verses.en: And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counsellor; and he was a good man, and a just:
verses.sm: Faauta foi, o le tagata e igoa ia Iosefa, o le faipule ia, o le tagata amio lelei ma le tonu;

verses.en: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.
verses.sm: (e lei faaopoopo o ia i la latou pule ma la latou mea na fai,) o le Arimataia o ia, o le aai lea o tagata Iutaia, o ia foi sa faatalitali atu i le malo o le Atua.

verses.en: This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.
verses.sm: Ua alu atu o ia ia Pilato, ma faanoi atu i le tino o Iesu.

verses.en: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.
verses.sm: Ua na ave ifo ai, ona aui lea i le ie lino, ona tuu ai lea i le tuugamau na foa i le papa, e lei tuu ai lava se tasi.

verses.en: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.
verses.sm: O le aso lea o le sauniga, ua latalata le sapati.

verses.en: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.
verses.sm: Ua mulimuli atu foi fafine e na o mai ma ia mai Kalilaia, ua latou vaavaai i le tuugamau, ma le tuuina ai o lona tino.

verses.en: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.
verses.sm: Ua latou toe foi atu, ua sauni mea manogi ma suāuu manogi; ua latou malolo foi i le sapati, e tusa ma le poloaiga.
